Class.summary: Controller responsible for aggregating system-wide analytics, key performance indicators (KPIs), workload metrics, and ticket trends.
Class.remarks: All endpoints in this controller are strictly restricted to users in the Admin role. Designed for administrative reporting, monitoring operational throughput, and agent capacity tracking.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The MediatR mediator instance used for dispatching dashboard analytics queries.
The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role from JWT claims.

GetStats.summary: Retrieves high-level system statistics, ticket status breakdowns, and resolution performance indicators.
GetStats.remarks: Restricted exclusively to users in the Admin role. Returns: TotalTickets: Overall count of tickets in the system. OpenTickets: Tickets currently in the Open state waiting for investigation. InProgressTickets: Tickets currently actively being worked on by assigned agents. ResolvedTickets: Tickets resolved by support agents waiting for customer review. ClosedTickets: Tickets fully closed. CriticalOpenTickets: Unresolved tickets with Critical priority requiring immediate attention. AverageResolutionTimeHours: Mean turnaround duration from creation to resolution in hours.
GetStats.returns: The aggregate dashboard KPI statistics response DTO.
GetStats.response: Returns the system KPI summary statistics.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.

GetAgentWorkload.summary: Retrieves real-time workload distribution and operational throughput across all Support Agents.
GetAgentWorkload.remarks: Restricted exclusively to users in the Admin role. Provides a per-agent breakdown: Agent GUID, DisplayName, and Email. AssignedTickets: Number of currently active tickets assigned to this agent. TotalMinutesLogged: Cumulative work minutes logged across all tickets. Useful for balancing queue workloads and identifying overloaded or underutilized agents.
GetAgentWorkload.returns: A list of agent workload response objects.
GetAgentWorkload.response: Returns the agent workload distribution metrics.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.

GetTicketTrends.summary: Retrieves daily ticket volume trends (created vs. closed) over a specified historical lookback period.
GetTicketTrends.remarks: Restricted exclusively to users in the Admin role. Lookback Range: days parameter must be between 1 and 365 (defaults to 30). Returns chronological daily buckets with date, count of created tickets, and count of closed tickets. Powers visual time-series charts on the admin analytics dashboard.
GetTicketTrends.param: The number of days to look back for trend analysis (1 to 365, default is 30).
GetTicketTrends.returns: A list of daily trend data points with date, created count, and closed count.
GetTicketTrends.response: Returns the daily historical trend data points.
If the days parameter is less than 1 or greater than 365.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.
